image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on dirt and twigs. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage: a black head with grey nape, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and black upperparts with distinct white wing bars and shoulder patches. A second, out-of-focus bird is visible in the background. The lighting is natural, highlighting the texture of the feathers and the ground.
